Each row also uses white, black and lined shading once. Row 3 is missing the small triangle with circle on the left and 3 legs, and the shading still missing is black, so the answer is option 1. Option 3 is black with the circle on the left but has only 2 legs.
trick: List the figure types and the shadings separately; the missing cell takes the type and shading not yet used in its row.
